# De bedste investeringer: Syv gæster fortæller om deres største gevinster

**Feed**: borsen-podcast  
**Published**: 2026-07-06  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

A retrospective episode of Børsen's 'Sådan investerar jag' where seven guests recount their single best investments, ranging from art and real estate to founding their own companies and a few standout stock picks. The dominant equity theme is long-term conviction in US mega-cap technology — Nvidia and the 'Magnificent Seven' — alongside compounder plays like MarketAxess, framed through Peter Lynch-style scuttlebutt investing.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 NVDA — Nvidia | **HOLD** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Ulla's best stock, up 14-15x; chips are the foundation of all technology and AI; holds 'always', only trimmed on portfolio overweight.

#### Reasoning

Guest Ulla Brockenhus-Schack expresses explicit long-term conviction, framing Nvidia as a 'category winner' central to the AI/tech thesis. She bought early (~5 yrs ago), realised 14-15x, and states she holds these dominant tech names indefinitely, selling only to manage position size. Sees robotics as the next frontier.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Nvidia loses its chip/AI category leadership
- if position grows to overweight the portfolio again

> *"I Nvidia har jag väl fått 14-15 gånger mina pengar hem"*

---

### 🟡 GOOGL — Alphabet | **HOLD** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Ulla holds Alphabet 'always'; YouTube is the world's largest streaming service, plus ad sales and AI infrastructure make it 'second to none'.

#### Reasoning

Guest Ulla cites Alphabet as her prime example of a company that dominates not just as a whole but across its subcategories (YouTube > Netflix in streaming, advertising, AI infrastructure). She holds the large US tech names long-term as category winners that 'can't go completely wrong', giving explicit LT conviction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Alphabet loses leadership in search/streaming/AI
- if valuation becomes extreme relative to fundamentals

> *"de inte bara som sällskap men också i de enkla subkategorierna som de arbetar med är världens förande"*

---

### 🟡 AAPL — Apple | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Named among the Magnificent Seven Ulla holds long-term as dominant category winners after trimming Nvidia.

#### Reasoning

Guest Ulla lists Apple among the large US tech stocks she rotated into and holds indefinitely, describing them collectively as extremely skilled firms that own their categories. Directional but less individually detailed than Nvidia/Alphabet, so moderate conviction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Apple loses category dominance
- if the mega-cap tech thesis breaks down

> *"de stora amerikanska tech-aktier, alltså Apple, Microsoft och... Alphabet"*

---

### 🟡 MSFT — Microsoft | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Named among the large US tech stocks Ulla owns and holds long-term as category leaders.

#### Reasoning

Guest Ulla includes Microsoft in the Magnificent Seven she holds 'always' as dominant, highly capable companies that own their categories. A clear long-term hold bias, but discussed as part of a basket rather than individually, hence moderate conviction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Microsoft loses its category leadership
- if the mega-cap tech thesis breaks down

> *"de stora amerikanska tech-aktier, alltså Apple, Microsoft och..."*

---

### 🟡 NFLX — Netflix | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Ulla notes Netflix has done very well among her tech holdings, though she flags YouTube is now bigger in streaming.

#### Reasoning

Guest Ulla says Netflix has performed really well and is part of her long-term tech basket, but she also notes YouTube surpasses it in streaming scale. Positive long-term hold with a competitive caveat, giving moderate conviction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if streaming competition (e.g. YouTube) erodes Netflix's position
- if subscriber growth stalls

> *"Netflix också faktiskt"*

---
